name: Thaumaturgy (Path of Shadowcrafting) — 1 Basic — Out Light

system.description:
You focus darkness upon a single light source no stronger than a torch, bulb, or neon sign within your sight, causing it to flicker, gutter, or snuff out entirely depending on your successes; a snuffed bulb or sign burns out permanently, while a candle can be relit later.

This path does not function against or for Kindred with the Flaw: Cast No Reflection.
system.source: Clanbook: Tremere, Chapter Two: Inside the Pyramid
